name: Post voting
summary: Readers vote a post up or down, and the score sets the order in which the posts show.
how: Put an up and a down control beside each post.
Show the net score between the two controls.
Sort the list by the score, or by the score and the age.

origin.note: Digg puts the links with the most votes from its users on its front page.

adoptions.via: Reddit adds up and down votes on each post and on each comment.
